context.validated_for: uncached long-context retrieval and sustained visible generation

caveats: Validated on one RTX 5060 Ti 16GB with IQ3_XXS and q8 KV at 64K, one request slot.
Measured with the seed cards' core/SM clock locked at 2300 MHz; throughput is specific to that operating point.
Retrieval passed twice at ~57.7K prompt tokens; sustained generation passed twice at ~45.9K prompt tokens with client-visible output required.
The model emits substantial hidden reasoning; the profile used the thinking-enabled route and required client-visible final content.
64K is the highest useful tier validated here. On this exact one-card route, 64K and 96K f16 KV failed to allocate, and 96K q8 failed while creating the MTP context. Not a maximum-context claim.
